newsitem.title: UK: Cargo wholsaler ICM restarts UK-Turkey service.
newsitem.headline: Cargo wholsaler ICM restarts UK-Turkey service.

text.p: UK cargo consolidator International Cargo Marketing (ICM) said it has resumed offering London-Istanbul services after an absence from the market of over a month.

Route controller-Europe Morag Fraser said ICM was forced to suspend its Turkish operation when Turkish airline Tayfunair stopped its twice-weekly London Gatwick-Maastricht-Istanbul Boeing 727 freighter services, which it used, in early March.
"For the first time, we are now using national carrier THY Turkish Airlines flights from London Heathrow to Istanbul," she said.
"We have carried a lot of traffic to Turkey in the past...it is a very busy ex-UK market," she added.
Per kg airport-to-airport rates being charged by ICM are 1.14 stg for below 100 kg, 1.09 stg for 100-300 kg, 1.04 for 300-500 kg, 0.99 for 500-1,000 kg and 0.93 for 1,000 kg and above.
ICM is a wholesaler specialising in consolidated shipments and its customers are mainly freight forwarders. It is a sister company of British Midland.
